notice: This is the MIDI-capable V-STAGE 76 with a 76-note semi-weighted waterfall keyboard. Use USB COMPUTER or DIN MIDI; USB MEMORY is storage, and EXTERNAL DEVICE ports host USB MIDI devices. Default receive channels: organ upper/lower/pedal 1/2/3, acoustic piano 4, electric piano 5, synth A/B 6/7. Match the configured part channels and receive filters. The three Synth A virtual offset controls use default channel 6 and centre value 64; change routing if reconfigured. Physical controls and shifted functions were extracted from the NYU tactile guide pp. 12-37 and checked against the Roland manual. They are an inventory, not a claim that every panel control sends a fixed CC. Virtual keyboard notes follow the hardware range; MIDI learn and routing may change the destination. Layout positions are schematic. Port names are unverified; select the profile manually. External USB host compatibility depends on supported USB MIDI devices; consult Roland. Swell-form or UV printing is required for raised tactile output; these SVGs remain schematic.
